name: dsh-calibguard
description: CalibGuard file-security auditing for DeepSeek Harness: a locally calibrated CodeBERT gate exposed as agent tools, with on-demand cloud LLM review of the gray zone.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['bridge','engine']){if(!fs.existsSync(d))continue;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){if(f.isDirectory()&&f.name==='__pycache__')fs.rmSync(d+'/'+f.name,{recursive:true,force:true});else if(f.isFile()&&f.name.endsWith('.pyc'))fs.rmSync(d+'/'+f.name,{force:true});}}"
